scripts.prepublishOnly: node -e "const p=require('./package.json'); const root=require('../package.json'); p.dependencies['md-merger']='^' + root.version; require('fs').writeFileSync('./package.json', JSON.stringify(p, null, 2)+'\n'); const {cpSync, existsSync} = require('fs'); if (existsSync('../defaults')) cpSync('../defaults', './defaults', {recursive:true}); else console.warn('defaults/ not found - skip copy')"
